messages:
Ana (SE): POC with function-calls + json_mode failing — parser errors and intermittent 429s during load test. Need quick triage.
Ben (AE): Demo tmrw, customer blocked. Any short-term fixes?
Ana (SE): App logs: `ValueError: Expecting value` — sometimes response is escaped like \"entities\": [...] or prefixed with RESULT:\n{...}.
Sam (Eng): Are you streaming? stream=true can split JSON in chunks and break parsers.
Ana (SE): yes
Sam (Eng): Quick fixes: set stream=false for the demo, or use json_mode: "relaxed" + cap max_output_tokens. Also add client-side schema validation (ajv) and a sanitizer that strips leading text before first { when not streaming.
Ben (AE): 429s show retry-after headers. Can we guarantee demo uptime?
quota-bot: Temporary quota request created (#Q-324). Provide expected RPS and time window to expedite.
Lara (Security): Customer wants log retention & KMS info. Hosted logs 30d; Dedicated/Private supports KMS and private control plane. I'll prepare SQA note.
Ana (SE): Will send customer snippet + sanitizer and request temporary bump. Will cc @Ben.
Ben (AE): pls cc me and confirm billing implication — retries are billed as requests.
Ana (SE): Confirmed. Closing loop: disabling stream + client-side schema check fixed parser in our repro. Demo ETA confirmed.
